stem: How are the selection and the poem different?

options.label: F
options.text: The selection encourages mining, while the poem discourages mining.

options.label: G
options.text: The selection focuses on several events, while the poem focuses on one event.

options.label: H
options.text: The selection relates facts, while the poem relates a personal experience.

options.label: J
options.text: The selection focuses on failures, while the poem focuses on successes.
